fields.summary_ko.0: NVDA declined over 7% in pre-market trading on Thursday following reports of possible CEO Jensen Huang management transition, ahead of November 17 Q3 FY27 earnings release.
fields.summary_ko.1: Wall Street average price target is $283.83 (63% upside), with Q3 FY27 EPS expected at $2.47 (+90% YoY) and revenue forecast at $108.84 billion (+91% YoY).
fields.summary_ko.2: Major 5-star analysts including KeyBanc, Melius Research, Evercore ISI, William Blair, Oppenheimer, and Bernstein downgraded due to management risk concerns, with Bernstein cutting its price target from $400 to $200.
